title: Failure reflection → LinkedIn English post
user_request: O projeto que lideramos falhou e precisamos recomeçar do zero
expected_output: We failed. And I mean that with full ownership — no excuses, no blame-shifting. The project didn't deliver what we promised. Now we're rebuilding from scratch, and honestly? It's the best thing that could have happened. Failure without reflection is just waste. Failure with it? That's your next edge.
notes: Input: Portuguese, honest failure context. Output: English, vulnerable and powerful LinkedIn tone. Show accountability without self-pity.
